verdict.rationale: skills.sh is a registry and CLI package manager that installs SKILL.md files into other coding agents. It is not itself an agent or tool consumer, so plugging MCP servers into it so that it can use their tools is a category error for this product type. The spec's experimental `allowed-tools` field and the community mention of managing MCPs via Nix are adjacent material and show no MCP-client capability in the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
